description: A corrected HSTU cold-start baseline for sequential recommendation on four Amazon categories: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Train one independent HSTU model per category and select changes using macro-average validation HR@10.
motivation: Establish a reproducible HSTU comparison under fixed data splits, seeds, evaluation candidates, and compute limits, while preventing target leakage and inconsistent training versus inference implementations.
implementation_notes: Use preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42, at most 200 epochs, and 200 batches per epoch. Preserve the supplied HSTU backbone, category routing, and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']. For left-padded histories, read the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Keep checkpoints, the predictor writer, working/predict.py, ModelView interfaces, and diagnostic probes consistent. Each category must load exactly one trained model; independent predictor fusion is prohibited. Use only permitted public data and validation feedback. The supplied description contains no baseline source code, architectural details, or measured results.
pseudocode:
Set preprocessing seed to 0 and training seed to 42.
For each of the four categories:
    Load the supplied fixed splits from GAGC_DATA_DIR.
    Initialize the supplied corrected HSTU model.
    Train within the epoch, batch, and shared compute limits.
    Preserve family-compatible diagnostics and prediction interfaces.
    Save one selected model checkpoint beneath the trial directory.
Generate working/predict.py with matching architecture and category routing.
Let the host evaluate validation HR@10 using its pinned protocol.
Compare proposals by mean validation HR@10 across all four categories.

originality.positive: Provides a carefully constrained, family-specific experimental baseline.
originality.negative: Describes an evaluation setup rather than a new modeling contribution; no novel HSTU mechanism is specified.

future_potential.positive: Supports controlled exploration of jointly trained HSTU layers, losses, sampling strategies, and optimization settings.
future_potential.negative: Improvement remains unverified; search must fit the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.

code_difficulty.positive: The supplied corrected baseline and fixed evaluator should reduce initial implementation work.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require synchronized training, checkpoint loading, embedded predictor generation, and family-specific diagnostics. Scores use a 1–10 scale, with higher difficulty indicating harder implementation.
